clips.label: Intermediate descriptions
clips.note: Shell with buildings → hollow shell → city · peak noise 0.78
clips.details:
Intermediate descriptions

0.5–1s: shell inhabited by buildings. 1.5–2s: hollow spiral pavilion. From 2.5s: the same canyon-city description as the direct version.

Starting noise rises from 0.40 to 0.78 across six paintings, then returns smoothly to 0.64 across three. Same opening, seeds and RTX 4090 runtime as the direct comparison.

Krea recurrent animation: each painting starts from the warped previous painting. Three Euler sampling intervals, CFG 1, bounded Lanczos motion. New paintings every 0.5 seconds; RIFE 4.25 creates the frames between them. 6.5 seconds at 24 fps, with 13 paintings.
